MANYAVAR.NS.d: Vedant Fashions Limited makes, trades and sells wedding and celebration wear, with markets including India, Nepal, North America, the UAE and the UK. It offers kurta sets, sherwanis and jackets for men, lehengas, sarees and gowns for women, and outfits for children. Its labels are Manyavar, Mohey, Twamev, Diwas and Mebaz, sold through franchised and multi-brand outlets.

MASTERTR.NS.d: Master Trust Ltd. offers financial services in India, including equity, derivatives, currency and commodity trading, wealth management, insurance, research and advisory, merchant banking and depository services. It also provides lending, broking and portfolio management.

MCLOUD.NS.d: Magellanic Cloud Ltd. is an IT services company headquartered in Hyderabad, established in 1981 as South India Projects Limited. Its services include custom software development, product engineering, quality assurance, cloud computing, and multi-cloud and DevOps automation.

MEDICAMEQ.NS.d: Medicamen Biotech Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company that makes and distributes medicinal formulations in forms such as tablets, capsules, syrups and ointments. Its range also includes oral rehydration solutions, mouthwashes and dental care products. It began in 1993 and is headquartered in New Delhi.

MIDWESTLTD.NS.d: Midwest Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MIDWESTLTD and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MONARCH.NS.d: Monarch Networth Capital Limited and its group entities offer financial solutions to corporate, institutional and retail clients in India. It operates three divisions: Financial Market Broking and Associated Services, Non-Banking Finance Activities, and Insurance Services.

NDTV.NS.d: New Delhi Television Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in television media business in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Television Media and Related Operations; and Retail/E-commerce. It operates NDTV 24X7, an English news channel; NDTV India, a Hindi news channel; and NDTV Profit- NDTV Prime, a business and infotainment channel.

NIMBSPROJ.NS.d: Nimbus Projects Limited is involved in real estate development and construction activities. The company undertakes residential and commercial projects. Nimbus Projects is based in India.

OBCL.NS.d: OBCL Limited, based in Raipur and established in 1994, provides transportation and logistics services in India. It handles full truckload, parcel and less-than-truckload shipments for industries including steel, coal, aluminium, cement, petrochemicals and paper.

OMINFRAL.NS.d: Om Infra Limited engages in the design, engineering, manufacture, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of hydro mechanical equipment for hydroelectric power and irrigation projects in India and internationally. It operates through Engineering, Real Estate, and Other segments.

PAVNAIND-SM.NS.d: PAVNA INDUSTRIES L is involved in the manufacturing of automotive components. The company is based in India.

QUESTLAB.NS.d: Quest Laboratories Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company that specializes in the manufacturing of a diverse range of pharmaceutical formulations. The company produces ethical, generic, and over-the-counter (OTC) drugs across various therapeutic segments, including antibiotics, antimalarials, anti-inflammatories, respiratory medications, diabetes treatments, antidepressants, antispasmodics, and antiemetics.

REGAAL.NS.d: Regaal Resources Ltd. is an Indian corn processor that makes and sells maize starch and derived products. Its range covers native and modified starches, dextrin, maize flour, baking powder, custard powder, icing sugar, liquid glucose, maltodextrin, dextrose and sorbitol, plus co-products such as germ, gluten, fiber and steep liquor. Established in 2012.

RELIABLE.NS.d: Reliable Data Services Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker RELIABLE and traded in INR. Its country is India.

RULKA.NS.d: Rulka Electricals Ltd. is a provider of comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, primarily focusing on the electrical and firefighting sectors in India. The company offers a range of services including electrical contracting for retail, commercial, and industrial projects, data works, turnkey electrical projects, and installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical components like DGs and transformers.

SAGILITY.NS.d: Sagility India Limited, established in 2021 and headquartered in Bengaluru, provides business process management services, mainly to healthcare and insurance clients in India, Jamaica, the Philippines, the United States and Colombia. Services include claims management, member engagement, benefits plan setup, payment integrity, credentialing, clinical case management and analytics.

SAURASHCEM.NS.d: Saurashtra Cement Limited produces and distributes cement and paint, reporting in Cement and Clinker, and Paints segments. Its cement includes ordinary Portland, Portland Pozzolana and SRPC grades, plus clinker, sold under the HATHI brand.

SETUINFRA.NS.d: Setubandhan Infrastructure Limited, a construction company, engages in the infrastructure development and construction businesses in India. It provides integrated engineering, procurement, and construction services. The company is involved in the construction of buildings, quarters, roads, bridges, airports, godowns, hospitals, etc. for government and semi-government authorities. It also constructs industrial buildings, residential and commercial complex, townships, health care centers, and institutional campus.

SINGERIND.NS.d: Singer India Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and trading of sewing machines and related products. The company provides sewing solutions for both home and industrial use. Singer India is based in India.

SMVD-SM.NS.d: SMVD POLY PACK LTD is involved in the manufacturing and supply of flexible packaging materials. The company produces various types of packaging films and laminates. It operates primarily in the Indian market.

SNOWMAN.NS.d: Snowman Logistics Limited provides integrated temperature-controlled logistics services in India. The company operates through three segments: Warehousing Services, Transportation Services, and Consignment Agency Services. It offers warehousing solutions that cover ambient, chilled, frozen, and blast freezing facilities.

SRTRANSFIN-ZJ.NS.d: Sec Red NCD Sr.VII represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, belonging to Series VII of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

STLTECH.NS.d: Sterlite Technologies Limited manufactures and sells telecom products and solutions in India and internationally. It offers fiber optical cables, optical fibers, and copper telecom cables; and fibre optical cable laying services. The company also designs and deploys high-capacity converged fibre, cable, and wireless networks; and designs, builds, and manages cloud-native software-defined networks. In addition, it exports its products and services.

TALWGYM.NS.d: Talwalkars Healthclubs Limited owns, operates, franchises, and manages gymnasia, fitness centers, and health clubs primarily in India and Sri Lanka. It operates 252 gyms across 84 cities in South Asia. The company was formerly known as Talwalkars Lifestyles Limited and changed its name to Talwalkars Healthclubs Limited in November 2018. Talwalkars Healthclubs Limited was founded in 1932 and is based in Mumbai, India.

TECHLABS.NS.d: Trident Techlabs Ltd. provides technology-based solutions to the aerospace, defense, automotive, telecommunications, semiconductor, and power distribution industries. It operates through the following businesses: Engineering and Power System.

TEXRAIL.NS.d: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Limited operates as an engineering and infrastructure company in India. It operates through three segments: Heavy Engineering, Steel Foundry, and Rail EPC. It offers payload stainless/high tensile steel freight, commodity-specific, special purpose freight, bottom discharge coal hopper, container flat, tank, defense equipment, and auto car wagons; and coach bogies, loco-shells, components, EMU coaches, under frames, and parcel and brake vans.

VCL.NS.d: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited, a textile maker established in 2005 in Ahmedabad, India, produces denim, printed fabrics, yarns, jeans, men's casual shirts and home textiles. Its shirting materials go to global brands, exporters, corporate buyers, traders, wholesalers and distributors.

VGL.NS.d: Varvee Global Ltd., founded in 1988, makes and distributes textiles to Indian and international markets. Its denim range includes ring, shirting, printed, stretch, satin and high fashion types, and it also provides non-denim fabrics such as poplin and suiting, cotton yarns and fibres.

VIDEOIND.NS.d: Videocon Industries Limited manufactures and distributes a range of consumer durables in India and internationally. The company operates through Consumer Electronics and Home Appliances, Crude Oil and Natural Gas, and Telecommunication segments. It offers televisions, refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. The company also engages in the exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas. Videocon Industries Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Aurangabad, India.

ZENITHSTL.NS.d: Zenith Steel Pipes & Industries Limited manufactures and sells steel pipes worldwide. The company offers electric resistance welded black, galvanized, and helical submerged arc welded pipes.
